stem.text: Genetic engineering is a technology that can be applied to medicine.
Explain what is meant by genetic engineering.

guidance: 1 ALLOW recombinant DNA in organism context

points.text: change / manipulate / alter / modify, (organism’s) DNA / genetic material / genome ;
transfer / add / insert, gene / allele / DNA (into a recipient organism) ;

markScheme.note: Point n follows the order of the transcribed marking points; table rows or source labels such as 3a and 3b retain their original wording.

explanation.text: A complete definition connects deliberate DNA manipulation to a change in an organism’s characteristics. Gene transfer is one way to achieve this because the inserted sequence can be expressed as a protein.

reasoningChain: Identify deliberate modification of genetic material.
State the intended phenotypic effect and the possible role of gene transfer.

stem.text: Outline how severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) can be treated by gene therapy.

guidance: 3 ECF if incorrect virus named e.g. adenovirus / AAV

5 ALLOW if patient cells stated to be T cells
7 ALLOW patient T cells returned to blood
8, 9 gene, cloned in / taken from, GM bacteria multiply transformed, patient / T / stem, cells T-lymphocytes / T-cells, produce ADA (protein / enzyme)

points.text: (normal / dominant) allele / gene, for ADA / adenosine deaminase ;
virus modified so it cannot replicate ; obtain and modify patient cells
get (haemopoietic / lymphoid) stem cells from (patient) bone marrow ;
mix / culture, (engineered) vector, with, patient’s / stem, cells (in vitro / ex vivo) ;
drug to increase stem cells (in bone marrow) before mp 4 OR drug / chemotherapy / radiotherapy, to kill stem cells (to make space) before mp 7 ; return modified cells to patient
reintroduce (GM / transgenic) cells to, patient / bone marrow / blood ;

markScheme.note: Point n follows the order of the transcribed marking points; table rows or source labels such as 3a and 3b retain their original wording.

explanation.text: In ex vivo gene therapy, patient cells are genetically modified outside the body and then returned. A functioning allele can restore ADA production in cells derived from the treated stem-cell population.

reasoningChain: Trace preparation of a safe vector carrying the functional allele.
Follow removal, modification and return of the patient’s cells.
